📲 Book on WhatsApp & How to Pay

Make your own booking right here on this website — pick your service, date and time, then send the booking straight to the salon.

  1. Choose your service, date and time in the booking form above, then tap “Book My Appointment on WhatsApp”. Your booking opens in WhatsApp — press Send.
  2. The salon confirms your appointment on WhatsApp — the slot, the total price and whether any advance is needed.
  3. Pay the way the salon confirms. They will share their own payment details on WhatsApp (for example paying at the salon, or a mobile payment). Only pay on the details the salon itself sends you in that chat — never pay anyone else.
  4. Send your payment screenshot / receipt on the same WhatsApp chat to confirm your payment, and keep the chat until your appointment.
📞 Call — 0306-7249397 💬 WhatsApp — 0306-7249397

WhatsApp: if the button opens a chat, send the booking there. If a number is not on WhatsApp, please use the Call button instead.
